description: Claude OAuth client identity contract shared by agents/providers/rose/transport.py and back-end/src/providers/rose/transport.ts. Both transports must advertise client_version. Every claudeAuth model in either pool registry must list the minimum client version Anthropic was observed to require for it, with the live evidence. Adding a claudeAuth model or changing the version requires a live check through the real transport and an entry here.
